notes: Desktop/wall-mount fanless unit (236 x 101.6 x 27mm); not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. All 8 RJ45 ports are 10/100/1000Mbps autosensing and PoE (802.3af, up to 15.4W/port, 46W total power budget) - grade eth-1g reflects the 1000BASE-T ceiling of the autosensing port. The 2 SFP uplink ports are Gigabit Fiber (1000BASE-X per IEEE 802.3z), graded eth-1g; actual reach/fiber type depends on the SFP module inserted (not fixed by the switch itself). Power input is an external 48V/1.25A AC-to-DC adapter ("power brick"), not an internal PSU - modeled as a dc-barrel input port on the chassis; the wall-side plug on the adapter's cord is a standard regional AC plug and not part of the switch itself. Physical silkscreen just numbers ports 1-8 and SFP 1-2 (no unique per-port names); named generically here consistent with NETGEAR's own port diagram. Sourced from NETGEAR's official datasheet (DS-GS110TP-25Jan21, downloads.netgear.com).
